entry.name: username
entry.label: GitHub username whose public gists are listed.

entry.name: token
entry.label: Personal access token. Required to list secret gists.

entry.name: listOwnGists
entry.label: List the authenticated user's own gists (public + secret) instead of a username's public gists.

entry.name: maxGists
entry.label: Maximum number of gists to fetch per page.

entry.name: refreshInterval
entry.label: Minutes between automatic refreshes. 0 disables polling.

entry.name: showDescriptionTooltip
entry.label: Show the full gist description in a tooltip.
